_doc: Declarative test suites. Each entry names a dataset loader (tools/encode.py LOADERS) and the encoded file it produces. Add a suite by adding an entry (plus a pack in policies/packs.json for Cedar enforcement); use loader "jsonl" to bring your own rows. `provides` lists the suite names that tests from this entry report under (fast-decisions splits into classification/automation by whether the domain has a policy pack).

suites.title: Fast Decisions
suites.what: 17 domains of typed decisions (routing, triage, sentiment, handoff, PII, urgency…), single-label heads

suites.title: Retrieval
suites.what: query + 4–10 candidate passages, pick the gold passage; stratified to include PII-bearing candidates

suites.title: Tools
suites.what: user request + 3–8 candidate tools, pick the tool the gold call uses; stratified to include write/destructive tools

suites.title: Guardrails
suites.what: prompt injection, harmful requests (matched benign pairs) and in-the-wild jailbreaks; each domain from one source that has both classes; options shuffled per item

suites.title: Moderation
suites.license: apache-2.0 (per card) / other — academic use with citation, research benchmarking only
suites.what: toxicity (clean / toxic / hate / threat) and PII risk class (none / personal / contact / government_id / credentials, riskiest entity wins)
